shipping.region.title: Region-specific shipping
shipping.region.hint: When several rules match, the longer region code wins — you can price Guangdong province and Shenzhen separately.
shipping.region.emptyHint: With no region rules, the default shipping fee applies everywhere.
shipping.freeShipping.title: Free shipping
shipping.freeShipping.hint: Once free shipping is on, fees are no longer calculated by region or quantity. Excluded regions still apply.
shipping.freeShipping.fieldHint: You cover all shipping costs, regardless of region or quantity.
shipping.freeShipping.onHint: Free shipping is on. Your default and region-specific fees are kept and will apply again if you turn it off.
shipping.default.title: Default shipping fee
shipping.default.hint: Used when no region rule matches. Charged per item, rounding up to the first tier.
shipping.blocked.title: Regions we don't ship to
shipping.blocked.hint: Matching regions cannot be ordered at all. This takes priority over free shipping — don't confuse it with 'not free shipping'.
shipping.empty.title: You haven't set up a shipping template yet, so this product currently ships free. Your changes apply to new orders.
shipping.editNotice: Editing a template only affects new orders. Orders already placed keep the snapshot taken when they were placed.
shipping.saveNotice: Saving applies to new orders. Orders already placed are unaffected.
shipping.err.firstQuantityInt: First-item quantity must be a whole number of at least 1
shipping.err.firstFeeFormat: Invalid first-fee amount; enter an amount of 0 or more
shipping.err.addQuantityInt: Additional-item quantity must be a whole number of at least 1
shipping.err.addFeeFormat: Invalid additional-fee amount; enter an amount of 0 or more
shipping.err.freeOverQuantityInt: The free-shipping quantity threshold must be a whole number of at least 1
shipping.err.freeOverAmountFormat: Invalid free-shipping amount threshold; enter an amount of 0 or more
shipping.err.regionMissing: Rule {index} hasn't selected any regions yet
shipping.err.duplicateRegion: Region code {prefix} is configured in more than one shipping rule
shipping.err.excludedConflict: Region code {prefix} already has a shipping rule; it can't also be marked as undeliverable
